Discharged on the second branch the repair specification allows -- "refuse the boundary persona explicitly rather than silently" -- because the first branch is measurably unavailable here, and the measurement is given rather than asserted. fitTextPerWidget was turned on for both documents as the assignment directs. It moves no byte on this family and the reason is measured: NO TEXT FIELD ON EITHER FORM CARRIES MORE THAN ONE WIDGET (only Checkbox2 and Check Box1 on the petition do, and they are buttons), and the module states that a single-widget field measures identically with the flag on. Each of the eight values was then measured on its own single widget with the shared fitter, and every one needs a font size BELOW the module's declared 6.0pt readable floor to fit on one line: Full Name 4.989pt, Defendant (petition) 4.431pt, CountyOf 4.243pt, Addr1 5.992pt, AddrCity 3.781pt, AddrZip 5.219pt, County (order) 5.549pt, Defendant (order) 4.921pt. Trying the declared minimum as a final rung (evaluateDeclaredMinimumSize) changes nothing, because 6.0pt is above every one of those eight requirements -- Addr1 misses by 0.2pt of width.
